name: shared_preload_libraries
description: Specifies a comma-separated list of shared library names to load into the PostgreSQL server at startup.
symptoms: Missing statistics collection (e.g., no query execution stats)
Failed CREATE EXTENSION due to unloaded required libraries
Increased per-connection startup latency for extensions

constraints.hard_rule: value must contain only valid, installed library names without paths or version suffixes

tuning_tips: Include only libraries required by extensions used across all sessions; avoid adding unused libraries as they increase memory footprint and postmaster startup time.
